analyst.summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail is now a smaller, more focused company after demerging its Madura Fashion & Lifestyle business (Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, and similar brands) in mid-2025, leaving mainly the Pantaloons value-fashion chain and ethnic-wear brands. Revenue for the continuing business grew about 11% this year, which is a genuine improvement, but losses widened rather than narrowed over the same period, so profitability has not yet caught up with the growth.
